title: Moab Off-Road
dek: Four days on KTM dirt bikes on the trails around Moab with a local guide, including Onion Creek and Chicken Run: slickrock and red-rock canyons, hoodoos and mesas, the snowy La Sal Mountains, and Castle Valley.

callout.name: Moab Moto Tours
callout.text: A guided off-road dirt bike tour with Dave Lohner of Moab Moto Tours, who knows every trail around Moab. Highly recommended.

days.label: Arrive
days.title: Moab
prose: A short flight from Las Vegas into Canyonlands Field and into Moab.

days.label: Day 1
days.title: Red-rock canyons south of Moab
prose: The first day on the dirt bikes, through canyons and past hoodoos south of town.

photos.cap: A vintage Mercedes overlander from Germany, parked in Moab

days.label: Day 2
days.title: Onion Creek, Castle Valley and the La Sals
prose: Up Onion Creek past the Fisher Towers, out to Castle Valley and into the La Sal Mountains, with fresh snow in the trees.

photos.cap: Snow in the La Sal Mountains

days.label: Day 3
days.title: Spires and slickrock
prose: West of town past red spires and out to the canyon rim.

days.label: Day 4
days.title: The last ride
prose: A final morning on the trails, from snowy forest roads back down to the desert.
